name: reader-container

surface.POST /convert?kind=&to=: R1, R2: a legacy or macro Office file or an RTF converted to docx, xlsx or pptx, macros never run, no link followed
surface.POST /frames?kind=: R3, R4: a picture decoded to upright PNG frames, then its facts (time, place, orientation)
surface.POST /archive?kind=&name=: R5: an archive's members as a stream of records within the bounds the caller sends, then its end, or a refusal
surface.GET /version: the image's tools and their versions

note: The fleet-member marker of a container member with one class (bundler R24-R27, R36, R37; K5637). `bundle` is the Worker that answers the plane's READER_CONTAINER service binding and hosts the class (src/worker.mjs), built by `npm run build` and guarded as every member's bundle is. `image` names the class's image only as repository@digest: `digest` and `source_sha256` are recorded by bundler's recordContainerDigest from the image container-images.yml publishes, which writes the same digest into wrangler.jsonc. The base is pinned by digest, as the Dockerfile's FROM; `packages` is the Debian package statement (bundler R27). The container has no internet (`egress` empty; the Worker's class sets enableInternet false): the Worker hands it every byte it reads, and it keeps nothing between requests (R8).
